summary: China's ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) is raising concerns over the future pricing power of Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and Micron as its plans for next-generation server DRAM prompt renewed scrutiny of competition in 2027 and 2028. title: Grab plays up Singapore roots, rules out Huawei maps in Taiwan as Foodpanda deal nears decision
summary: Southeast Asian super-app Grab is trying to ease concerns in Taiwan about its ties to China as regulators near a decision on its proposed acquisition of Foodpanda's Taiwan business.

title: Taiwan panel makers enter semiconductor fight as structural challenges persist
summary: Entering the fourth quarter of 2026, panel makers face pressure from rising component costs and weakening demand. title: Taisic Materials expands SiC capacity for AI data centers, 8-inch markets

summary: Taiwan's Energy Management Act is undergoing its first major revision in nearly a decade, driving businesses to reassess self-generation and energy storage systems (ESS) as the market shifts from equipment installation alone toward returns, safety, and long-term operations.

title: AI substrate material shortages ease, but advanced equipment emerges as expansion bottleneck
summary: As the customer base for AI accelerators expands rapidly and consumes IC substrate capacity, advanced packaging remains a critical industry bottleneck. summary: Samsung affiliates plan to invest a combined KRW12.26 trillion (approx. summary: At the Paris Motor Show, Stellantis NV CEO Antonio Filosa rejected proposals to split the company's European and US brands and said the company would not sell Maserati. The automaker is pursuing a US$70 billion restructuring plan as it seeks to reverse a sharp decline in its share price.

title: Taiwan seeks to produce more Nobel laureates
summary: Taiwan has not seen a locally born and educated Nobel Prize winner in the last 40 years since Yuan-Tseh Lee became a laureate in chemistry in 1986.
